findings.claim: _targets strips a leading .okf/ before it checks for docs/, so .okf/docs/how-to/run.md is accepted and writes docs/how-to/run.md, a file other than the one spelled. That breaks the docstring's own promise that an oddly spelled id is refused rather than resolved to some other file.

verdict.text: The change does what the plan asks.
A folder id verifies every page under it that `kmctl review due` lists, and the page set comes from the new shared `kmctl.pages` module.
Repository-root paths work.
`decisions/index`, `log` and `handoffs` are refused.
Refusals for `decisions/*` and `decisions/index` name `kmctl verify decisions`.
One small spelling bug remains: `.okf/docs/...` is read as a docs page.
The fix is plain, so it does not need to come back to me.
Gates: I re-ran `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree.
Lint, format, tests, integration and rows r1 to r6 all passed: "stamp green: 94165b734effec3063cf1e90555234d687aedc49d2e6bc153fa7636cb2c493d6".
Code: I read `pages.py`, the `verify.py` diff (`_pages`, `_folder_hint`, `_targets`, `--by` moved into `verify_all`, dedup by canonical id), the `review_due.py` move, and the CLI help and epilog.
Probes in a scratch repo: `./decisions/0001-a` and `decisions/../decisions` are refused with the canonical spelling.
`decisions/*` gets the folder hint.
`.okf` and `docs` are refused.
`.okf/docs/how-to/run.md` is accepted and writes `docs/how-to/run.md` (f1).
r1: the test checks exit 0, three ids, an entry on each record, three log lines, the index byte for byte, and that the manifesto is untouched.
Its three cases cover `decisions`, `decisions/` and `.okf/decisions`.
r2: the test checks both pages get entries, and that `README.md` and a page outside the folder stay unchanged.
r3: the test asserts the printed id for `.okf/decisions/0001-a.md`, `.okf/manifesto.md` and `docs/how-to/run.md`.
The ids are hardcoded, but they are the ids review due prints.
r4: the test checks exit 1, empty stdout, a single refusal line, and that no file in the repo changed.
It covers `decisions/index`, `.okf/decisions/index.md`, `log`, `handoffs`, `.okf/handoffs/`, a README and a prototype non-README.
r5: the test asserts `kmctl verify decisions --by human:jasper` is on stderr for `decisions/*`, `.okf/decisions/*`, `decisions/index` and a missing id.
r6: the help test asserts the folder form, the `.okf/...md` path form and the folder example.
`test_help.py` passes.
r7 (judgment): ADR 0059 exists as a draft.
It states the folder form and explains why it does not undo ADR 0055's `--base` rejection: the person types the folder name, while `--base` picks pages by what a branch changed.
It is linked from `decisions/index.md`, and ADR 0055 has a dated correction that links it.
Pass.
Consistency: `docs/reference/commands.md`, both okf-bundle instructions, the `OLD_RULES` hash and its comment, and the `verify_all` docstring all match the code.
`.claude/rules/okf-bundle.md` only mentions verify for the summary and `verified` entries.
It never describes id forms, so leaving it unchanged is right.
No checklist lines were printed for this round.
f1 (bug, non-blocking): `cid = given.rstrip("/").removesuffix(".md").removeprefix(".okf/")` runs before `docs = cid.startswith("docs/")`, so `.okf/docs/how-to/run.md` verifies `docs/how-to/run.md`.
It also makes a concept folder named `.okf/docs/` unreachable.
Fix: refuse the id when what is left after stripping `.okf/` starts with `docs/`, or strip `.okf/` only for the concept branch.
Add a refusal case to the r4 test.
`kmctl verify docs` is refused with "at .okf/docs(.md)", which reads oddly.
The plan does not ask for the whole docs folder, so this is not a finding.
`_pages` walks the tree once per argument.
A glob over 59 records walks it 59 times.
That is fine at this size.
